english.note: Use 想 as the all-purpose colloquial choice for wanting to do something, wishing for something, or wishing to meet someone.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for wanting something or wanting to do something.
Use 想 as the all-purpose colloquial verb for wanting or would liking something.
This is the all-purpose choice for wanting or wishing for something.
This is the all-purpose casual choice, especially in 想 + goal or 想 + verb when the ambition is clear from context.
Use 想 for an everyday hope or wish, such as wanting to become something in the future.
Use 想 when would makes a request or statement sound tentative, indirect, or polite rather than firm.
Use this for wanting or being willing to have or do something, including polite offers such as wanting another piece.
